new_discriminator.name: NATIVE_CVEC_POSITION_CARRIER_DECOMPOSITION_GATE
new_discriminator.why_two_baselines: Splitting prompt decode into prefix then final token can itself change floating-point/logit behavior. BASELINE_FULL vs BASELINE_SPLIT measures that scheduling drift instead of misclassifying it as a cvec effect.
new_discriminator.why_two_broadcasts: BROADCAST_FULL vs BROADCAST_SPLIT measures cvec plus batch-schedule sensitivity while preserving the same all-token intervention semantics.
new_discriminator.last_token_only_semantics: Decode prefix with cvec disabled, synchronize, then enable cvec and decode the final prompt token alone.
new_discriminator.prefix_only_semantics: Enable cvec for prefix, decode and synchronize, clear cvec, then decode final prompt token baseline. This isolates persistent prefix/KV-mediated influence.
new_discriminator.promotion_language: Even perfect agreement does not prove the interventions are causally identical. It can support carrier robustness of the measured target-specific effect under two intervention scopes.
